subject.title: fix(signal): restore native replies for Signal sends

question: Should the conflict resolution retain the PR's shared delivery-confirmed reply reservation contract across all send paths, or narrow the merge to Signal quote persistence?
rationale: Both approaches address part of the Signal regression, but repository history cannot decide whether the compatibility and message-delivery blast radius of the shared contract change is intended.

options.title: Keep The Shared Contract
options.body: Port the reservation invariant onto current main and validate streaming, tool, queue, CLI/MCP, Signal, and sibling-channel paths.

options.title: Narrow To Signal Persistence
options.body: Land only Signal-owned durable quote context and defer shared reply-slot semantics to a separate focused PR.

options.title: Pause The Branch
options.body: Keep the PR draft until maintainers are ready to select and prove the permanent shared reply contract.

recommendation.title: Keep The Shared Contract
recommendation.body: Port the reservation invariant onto current main and validate streaming, tool, queue, CLI/MCP, Signal, and sibling-channel paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared reply-reference and message-tool threading contract traces most strongly to his prior merged work.
